alate: Head densely covered with short pubescence and scattered long hairs. Head nearly circular, width slightly greater than length (excluding mandibles); fontanelle distinct, situated slightly towards the posterior end; Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes large and prominent, usually circular; ocelli broadly oval, relatively close to the compound eyes. Postclypeus arched, length slightly less than half the width, anterior margin rather flat, posterior margin arcuate and projecting; anteclypeus almost trapezoidal; labrum roof-shaped, anterior margin rounded. Antennae with 15 segments. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin thickened, posterior margin with a distinct triangular notch in the middle. Forewings and hindwings shed, the forewing scale longer than the hindwing scale. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
distribution: Mengga, Luxi, Yunnan, 1375 m above sea level.
soldier: Head and base of the mandibles yellowish brown, turning reddish brown from the inner-margin tooth to the apical teeth; labrum and antennae pale yellow; pronotum slightly paler than the head. Head covered with sparse fine hairs, several pairs of long hairs between the apex of the labrum and the clypeus, the mandibular base with short hairs, the anterior part of the postmentum with a few scattered long hairs; thorax and abdomen with long and short hairs interspersed. Head length slightly greater than the width, the base of the mandibles slightly narrowed, widest behind the middle; in lateral view the highest point of the head dorsum near the posterior end, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. Labrum ligulate, slightly narrowed apically, the margins transparent. Mandibles stout, flattened and broad at the base, left mandible with two undulate prominences from the outer base to the middle, with a triangular marginal tooth near the middle, right mandible also with a triangular marginal tooth near the middle. Postmentum broad, short and flat, narrowest at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 equal in length. Pronotum elongate semi-elliptical and erect, deeply concave at the junction of the anterior and posterior lobes, the posterior lobe wider than the anterior lobe. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
